name: znetwork_create_empty_dispatch_handler_list
description: zNetwork::CreateEmptyDispatchHandlerList allocates the packet-dispatch sentinel node, self-links it, stores it globally, and resets the dispatch-handler count.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zNetwork dispatch-list/source-cluster pass.
Binary Ninja still renders the MSVC global-constructor flag byte as an apparent incoming ECX fragment; callers and source model do not expose an authored parameter.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja disassembly for 0x48bfb0 has no current warnings and validates allocation of a 12-byte zNetworkDispatchHandlerListNode, self-linking next and prev to the sentinel, storing the sentinel in g_zNetwork_DispatchHandlerListSentinel, and resetting g_zNetwork_DispatchHandlerListCount to zero.
The dependency frontier for 0x48bfb0 reports no source blockers; the only direct callee is compiler/runtime operator new.
Binary Ninja caller evidence for zNetwork::InitMessageHandlers shows a no-argument call to CreateEmptyDispatchHandlerList followed by RegisterDispatchHandlerListShutdown.

Native smoke znetwork_dispatch_handler_list_smoke reaches CreateEmptyDispatchHandlerList through zNetwork_InitMessageHandlers and verifies a non-null self-linked sentinel with dispatch-handler count zero before exercising delete-all and shutdown cleanup behavior.
